title: Vibrant Paint Drip Abstract
description: A dynamic abstract composition of vibrant, fluid paint splatters and thick drips flowing downward across a white surface. Bright overlapping colors form an energetic central mass with organic shapes, bubbles, and vertical streams in multiple hues.
prompt: abstract painting featuring vibrant fluid paint splatters and thick colorful drips flowing vertically down a white canvas, energetic overlapping layers of bright yellow, lime green, orange, teal, and magenta with organic bubble shapes and dynamic movement, high contrast, expressive acrylic style
